attempted_claim: Let (M,g,K) be axisymmetric, vacuum, maximal, asymptotically flat with a strictly stable axisymmetric MOTS Sigma of area A and Komar J nonzero and deficit delta=A/(8pi|J|)-1 in (0,1]. Let u be a Jang blow-up solution diverging to +infinity at Sigma with cylindrical limit Sigma x R. Then its 1/4-neck proper height satisfies H_{1/4}>=sqrt(A)/(8 sqrt(delta)). Equivalently small deficit forces an explicitly long Jang cylinder.
claim_type: PDE blow-up geometric estimate with rigidity witness
decisive_failure: No certified Jang neck-height bound was proved and no short-neck counterexample was constructed; the Dain-trial scaling table is exploratory Simpson quadrature without interval enclosures, and the Metzger onset-to-height link with the explicit 1/8 constant for general data was not built. Artifacts are preserved for future work but do not support an auditable claim within this session.
